title: Azure Plate-Breaker's Discourse

title: Treatise on River-Weight and Paired Heads

title: River Confluence Mace Manual

title: Paired Strokes Beyond the Basin

title: Wind-Sworn Crushing Oaths

title: Monarch's Wind-Held Mace Discipline
